remarks: ***Highest & Best: 16 Donna #20 (Thurs, Jan 15 @ 2PM)***  If you've been searching for a move-in-ready townhome that keeps life simple, 16 Donna Dr #20 is calling your name. Set in the Westnor community in West Norwalk, you're minutes to I-95, shopping, dining, and everyday errands, with an easy commute in any direction. The unit offers a private entrance and a quiet, residential feel within a well-maintained complex. Inside, the main level is bright and easy, with a comfortable living room, dining area, and sliders out to a private patio. The kitchen and baths are original but clean and functional, giving you the opportunity to update over time without needing to do a thing on day one. Upstairs are two light-filled bedrooms with updated flooring and a full bath. The finished lower level adds real flexibility, perfect for a rec room, office, or workout space, plus laundry and storage. Outside, enjoy the patio along with community amenities including a pool and playground. A solid, well-kept home that's ready now and easy to make your own over time.
